description: Create an organization that you will own after human approval. Evaluation periods are limited to 3 per account for its lifetime; organization_evaluation_limit_reached refuses further trials, including after deletion. Existing paid organizations keep their access. Requires stella:organization_create account consent for OAuth callers. Omit slug to generate an opaque organization address. Explicit slug conflicts return organization_slug_conflict; restricted accounts return account_access_unavailable. Send Idempotency-Key to safely replay a creation. The current organization stays active. Run stella auth login and select the returned organization before acting in it.

slug.description: Optional URL slug. Omit to generate an opaque organization address.
